title: Home
content: Home Nexus-UX Engine 2.0 Public Beta Ready Modern HTML-First Reactive Architecture A high-performance reactive user experience framework coordinating declarative HTML directives with web-native browser APIs. Built for Zero-Copy Zero-Serialization ZCZS execution directly across the DOM namespace. Explore Interactive Labs Visual Node Graph Specification Docs Live Runtime Engine 60 FPS Reactive Signal Binding Count 1 Count -1 Zero serialization Zero-copy live proxy heap Core Architectural Pillars Engineered from the ground up for maximum browser performance zero memory churn and pure HTML-first expressiveness. Declarative HTML-First DOM-as-State composition without imperative scripting Application logic state bindings dynamic templates and animations are expressed directly in HTML markup. No build step required to run templates parse natively in the browser s DOM parser. Implementation Features 30 Native Attribute Directives data-signal data-bind data-for data-if data-show data-on data-flow and more. Constructable CSSStyleSheets Direct CSSOM integration via document.adoptedStyleSheets and data-stylesheet . Single Observer Context Exactly one universal MutationObserver orchestrating all DOM insertions diffing and deterministic teardowns. Zero-Copy Zero-Serialization Strictly eliminates JSON serialization and memory copy overhead State is held in shared memory references and typed heaps. Web Workers and main thread communicate via SharedArrayBuffer completely avoiding expensive JS

Omni-State DOM-as-State Framework. Nexus-UX is a reactive framework designed for developers who demand absolute performance granular control and a zero-build experience. It collapses the traditional frontend stack by treating the DOM as a queryable reactive state graph while achieving 100 functional parity with Tailwind v4 . --- The Five Pillars 1. Omni-State DOM-as-State We assert that the DOM _is_ the primary state graph. No phantom Virtual DOM. No reconciliation tax. The HTML attributes are the declaration source while the binary signal heap is the runtime truth. 2. Native JIT Engine Tailwind v4 Nexus-UX achieves 1 1 bit-for-bit parity with the official Tailwind v4 CDN. It compiles utility classes into a high-performance Unified Adopted StyleSheets Registry in real-time. 3. Zero-DOM Pollution Using CSSStyleSheet.replaceSync Nexus-UX eliminates all legacy and tag pollution. Styles automatically penetrate Shadow DOM boundaries without duplicative parsing. 4. ZCZS Zero-Copy Zero-Serialization A value-pooling reactive core designed for 120fps animations. Data flows from kernel to DOM via binary signal heaps bypassing JSON serialization. 5.
